archetype_selected.name: Swiss & High-Contrast (Marine Customization)
archetype_selected.reasoning: A highly functional hybrid application (marketing + dashboards). Combining the precision and authority of Swiss High-Contrast with the nautical branding requirements (Deep Navy and bright Coral/Cyan accents) to project trust, speed, and navigation.

theme.notes: Marketing pages should feature dark, immersive hero sections (Deep Navy) transitioning into bright, highly legible light-themed (Slate 50) sections. Both Employer and Job Seeker dashboards MUST be primarily light-themed for data legibility.

rules.h1: text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-slate-900

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: MODE A: TETRIS GRID. Asymmetry and visual tension. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: MODE B: CONTROL ROOM. Dense and scanable. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Flat rectangular cards without generic drop shadows. Utilize 1px solid borders for separation.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-none or rounded-md (max 8px) to maintain the sharp Swiss-modern aesthetic.

hero_background.description: Abstract 3D topographical map ocean waves, deep navy blue and bright cyan colors
hero_background.usage: Marketing Home Hero background behind 'bg-black/40' overlay.

nautical_icons.usage: Use in 'Services' and 'How it Works' section as premium 3D illustrations.

lifestyle_photography.usage: About Page hero or For Employers banner background.
Testimonial or Job Seeker dashboard welcome card.
For Job Seekers marketing section imagery.

navigation.behavior: Sticky Nav. Backdrop blur heavy (backdrop-blur-xl). bg-white/70 or bg-[#0A192F]/80 depending on active theme section.
navigation.items: Home, For Job Seekers, For Employers, Services, About, Login/Register
navigation.style: Crystal Glass style. 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/20 or border-slate-200/50).

hero_section.headline: Navigate Your Next Opportunity
hero_section.structure: Dual CTAs (Primary Accent #FF5959, Secondary Solid White or Transparent with Border). Prominent Job Search Bar overlapping the hero bottom edge.
hero_section.search_bar: Must include Smart Filters (job type, experience, remote/on-site, salary range) with removable chips. Highly elevated with ambient shadow.

job_seeker_dashboard.widgets: Recommended Jobs, Saved Jobs, Applied Jobs, Job Alerts.
job_seeker_dashboard.profile_builder: Progress bar indicator, resume upload dropzone. Clean Shadcn form logic styled sharp.
job_seeker_dashboard.job_cards: Flat design, 1px border. Side panel (Sheet/Drawer from Shadcn) overlay for deep job details.

employer_dashboard.layout: Control Room Grid (Mode B). Real-time feel.
employer_dashboard.kanban_pipeline: New, Shortlisted, Interview, Offered, Hired. Must use horizontal scroll. Kanban columns should have distinct background tint.
employer_dashboard.candidate_search: Table view with AI/Score matching columns, clear messaging/contact action buttons.

interactive_elements.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (max rounded-md). Hover state MUST NOT rely on opacity alone; shift hue or background color.
interactive_elements.inputs: Shadcn defaults stripped of generic 'Vercel' look. Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00B4D8] focus:border-transparent.

motion_and_interaction.scrolling: Lenis library MUST be implemented for momentum smooth scrolling on marketing pages.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Cards should have subtle translate-y-1 and enhanced shadow. Text colors inside CTAs must explicitly remain accessible on hover.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Framer motion for stagger children (opacity and slight y-axis slide) when grids mount.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast ratios, especially white text on the cyan gradient.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: data-testid='job-search-submit-button', data-testid='apply-job-button', data-testid='kanban-column-interview'.

library_recommendations.icons: lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone style for premium feel).
library_recommendations.ui_primitives: shadcn/ui (radix-ui) for all complex interactions (Sheet, Dialog, Tabs, Select).
